last_quiz.subject: ENGLISH
last_quiz.question: Select the sentence in which the subjunctive mood is used correctly.

options.A: If I was you, I would apologize.
options.B: If he were to arrive early, we could start the meeting.
options.D: It is essential that he attends the meeting.

last_quiz.explanation: The subjunctive form after "if" for hypothetical situations uses "were" (or "were to"). Sentence B follows this rule; the others misuse the subjunctive.
